_comment: Written by contracts/script/Deploy.s.sol. Single source of truth for addresses — read by the SDK, the API and the dashboard. Entries under `verified` were confirmed to have bytecode on Sepolia on the date shown; entries that are still the zero address have not been deployed yet, and the API refuses to start in production mode while any of them are.

accountImplementation._comment: Pinned per PRD 8.2. Its HookManager calls postCheck(bytes) — selector 0x173bf7da — not the draft postCheck(bytes,bool,bytes) (0xaacbd72a). AgentPolicyHook implements the former; test/integration/RealAccount.t.sol installs the hook on this account and drives it through a real EntryPoint to prove it.
accountImplementation.name: MSAAdvanced (ERC-7579 reference implementation)

uniswapUniversalRouterLegacy._comment: The pre-v4 Universal Router. Kept here because it was previously listed as *the* router and it does have bytecode, which is exactly why the mistake survived: it has had no traffic in the window we sampled, and no v4 pool routes through it. Not allowlisted.

verified.method: eth_getCode against a public Sepolia node; see scripts/verify-deployment.ts
